device.description: Low-voltage 10-bit serial SAR ADC with 4 analog inputs, EOC, programmable conversion rate and power-down
device.note: slas139c.pdf (SLAS139C) p.1 pinouts (D/PW 16-pin, DB/J 20-pin), p.3-4 terminal functions, p.4-5 detailed description and microprocessor serial interface, p.6 Table 2 interface modes, p.7 Table 3 software-programmed operation modes, p.9 CSTART and Table 4, p.10-11 conversion rate (Table 5), power-down, power up and initialization, p.14 recommended operating conditions, p.16-17 operating characteristics (tconv, td(I/O-DATA), tPZH, tPHZ)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: CH = last selected channel (p.11: the input data register is set to all zeroes at power up); RATE = conversion rate, 1 = fast (9h), 0 = slow (Ah). The power-up rate is not documented (p.11: it must be programmed); reset 0 here

commands.name: Select analog channel 0-3
commands.note: p.7 Table 3: 0000b/0010b/0100b/0110b select channel 0/1/2/3 on the TLV1544; conversion starts at the 10th I/O CLK rising edge (p.5). Wakes from software power-down (p.11)

commands.name: Odd channel code (not listed for TLV1544)
commands.note: p.7 Table 3 lists only the even codes for the TLV1544; the odd codes are not documented (no conversion modeled)

commands.name: Software power down set
commands.note: p.7 Table 3 8h: no conversion result; p.11: power-up restored during the next access (CS low)

commands.name: Fast conversion rate (10 us) set
commands.note: p.7 Table 3 9h: no conversion; p.10-11 Table 5 (VCC 3.3-5.5 V only)

commands.name: Self-test voltage (Vref+ - Vref-)/2 selected
commands.note: p.7 Table 3 Bh: output result 200h (read in the next cycle)

commands.name: Reserved
commands.note: p.7 Table 3 Eh/Fh: no conversion result

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3-4 (terminal functions), p.5-6 (serial interface, Table 2), p.7 (Table 3 commands), p.9-11 (CSTART, conversion rate, power-down, initialization), p.14 (ROC), p.16-17 (timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, reference and the analog multiplexer (the result is the 0 V code 000h except the self-test codes)

the output in each cycle is the PREVIOUS conversion result, MSB at CS fall, the other bits on I/O CLK falling edges, low from the 10th falling edge; the constant 0 V code hides the pipeline (the self-test results use the next frame)
INV CLK = GND (input data clocked on falling edges while the output still changes on falling edges) and the INV CLK built-in test mode: the model assumes INV CLK = VCC (SPI mode 0)
DSP mode (FS low at CS fall: FS-framed cycles, data on the other clock edges, 16-clock frames with 6 trailing zeros) is not modeled; FS must be tied high

extended sampling via CSTART: CSTART rising starts a conversion (pins.convst), but the AsyncFlag (the next CS cycle is read-out only, no conversion) and the CSTART-only-while-CS-high condition are not modeled
conversion time: fast 10 us max, slow 25 us max (p.16 tconv; Table 3 names the slow rate 40 us, which is the total cycle time); the fast rate is only for VCC 3.3-5.5 V

power-down: 8h powers down; any following access wakes it (modeled by every other command starting with a wakeup action, so the wake happens when that command completes, not at CS fall); the first conversion after power-down/power-up is invalid
CS low during a cycle aborts it (td(I/O-CS) 1.1 us); EOC fall delay 240 ns after the 10th clock is not timed
the output data register is random at power up (the model outputs the 0 V code)
I/O CLK frequency limits (2.81 MHz at 2.7 V, 10 MHz at 5.5 V) and source-impedance dependence (Table 1)
variants: TLV1548 (same datasheet): 8-channel version (DB/J/FK packages), separate device.
